issuer: Statens vegvesen (the Norwegian Public Roads Administration), at its traffic stations
note: Statens vegvesen's pages (read 2026-10-30): the theory test page's age limits put Personbil (B) at 18; the price list (prices from 1 February 2026) gives issuing a licence at 270 kroner paid at a traffic station, 160 online (the station's held; the tests and photograph aren't); the renewal page says the licence card itself is valid for 15 years from issue (its administrative validity). Norway's national ID card is the Police's and isn't held; no exchange list was read.
